statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band on a contained, twice-retraced overnight range, while Stress stays high on multidecade-high long-end yields, 90-dollar crude, a 12-year low in consumer confidence and a dense quarter-end release and earnings stack.
recommendation: Tail is below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON. A narrow danger window is flagged from 12:15 to 15:00 UTC covering ADP, the Core PCE and final GDP block, the US cash open and Chicago PMI. The 20:00 UTC quarter-end close and the Micron results after the bell are separately flagged as conditional WATCH hours in the forecast. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: Twice-retraced overnight band holds Tail low into the last Core PCE before the October FOMC
body:
NQ futures trade 30,575 to 30,591 after printing 30,737 and 30,540 overnight, a band of roughly 197 points or 0.64% in which both extremes were retraced rather than held. Price now sits in the lower half of that band, about 50 points off the session low, with no repeated extension and no failed retracement observed. ES is tighter still at 7,733 to 7,757, a 0.3% band, and VIX at 16.04 is unchanged near the low of its own 15.81 to 16.06 range. Nasdaq-100 cash closed Tuesday at 30,339.33, up 0.21%, mid-range and roughly 90 points below the session high, so the most recent cash print also ended in a retracement rather than at an extreme. This is the second consecutive contained session without observed directional efficiency, which is why Tail stays in the low band.

The Stress backdrop is unchanged and severe. H.15 shows the 2-year at 4.92%, the 10-year at 5.24% and the 30-year at 5.56% as of September 28, with the long end near multidecade highs and up 7 to 11 basis points over the prior week. WTI is 90.51 dollars, up 1.27%, and Brent 97.41 dollars, up 1.30%, both heading for a monthly gain above 5% while the US-Iran tanker conflict around the Strait of Hormuz continues; regional exports have nevertheless recovered to about 12.8 million barrels per day, so this is a persistent conflict rather than a fresh discontinuity. Conference Board consumer confidence fell 6.7 points to 81.9, its lowest since 2014 and far below the 89.2 consensus, with the Expectations sub-index at 63.6. After New York Fed President Williams said there is no need for urgency, market-implied odds of an October hike fell from roughly 70% to about 50%, with one further increase still expected before year-end.

Only MBA mortgage applications, at -1.5%, has been released so far today. ADP at 12:15 UTC and the Core PCE, PCE, final Q2 GDP and personal income and spending block at 12:30 UTC are still ahead, followed by the 13:30 UTC cash open, Chicago PMI at 13:45 and EIA crude stocks at 14:30. This is the last Core PCE before the October 27-28 FOMC. Micron reports fiscal Q4 after the close, on the last day of the quarter. Event density of this kind raises Stress and shapes Confidence weighting; it is not by itself evidence of the pathological no-retracement price path that Tail measures, so the conditional lift is confined to the WATCH band in the relevant hours rather than applied to the current state.

The shared Finviz context file was read and rejected as evidence: its generatedAt of 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z is about 11 hours old, well beyond the 90-minute freshness limit, and its collectionStatus is partial with the futures and calendar sections unavailable. This assessment therefore rests entirely on independently verified current sources, and the resulting completeness gap is reflected in Confidence rather than treated as a publication blocker.

lookbackSummary: Twenty-three of the past 24 hourly slots carry a published Claude assessment; the 14:00 UTC slot on September 29 has none and stays explicitly unavailable. The window opens in the WATCH band with Tail 20 to 21 and Stress in the mid to high 70s through the September 29 US session, peaking at Tail 24 with a trend-down read at 15:00 UTC. From 20:00 UTC Tail crossed back under 20 and the mapped state returned to EA_ON, after which Tail ground down from 19 to 15 and Stress decayed from 71 to 65 across the Asian and European hours. The last nine slots are all green with Tail 15 to 16, which is the contained two-session base this assessment continues from.
outlookSummary: The low Tail band is expected to hold through the remainder of the European morning while NQ stays inside its overnight band. Conditional Tail lifts into the WATCH band for the 12:00 to 14:00 UTC hours covering ADP, the Core PCE and final GDP block, the US cash open and Chicago PMI, peaking at 22 in the 13:00 UTC hour, then decays through the US afternoon if the releases are absorbed with normal retracements. A second conditional lift into the WATCH band covers the 20:00 and 21:00 UTC hours for the quarter-end cash close and the Micron fiscal Q4 results after the bell, where thin post-close futures liquidity amplifies gap risk. Tail then settles at 16 to 17 across the Asian and early European hours of October 1, with Confidence tapering from 88 to 82 at the far edge of the horizon. Stress stays in the high band throughout, between 65 and 74, because the long-end yield, energy and rate-path backdrop does not resolve inside this window.
